title.value: Data-efficient Reinforcement Learning with Self-Predictive Representations
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: D ATA -E FFICIENT R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING WITH S ELF -P REDICTIVE R EPRESENTATIONS

analysis.description: The paper introduces a novel self-supervised paradigm, named Self-Predictive Representations (SPR), to improve the data efficiency of deep reinforcement learning models. The method enhances reward maximization with self-supervised objectives based on the agent's visual input and interaction with the environment. SPR extends model-free agents by adding a dynamics model that predicts future latent representations and incorporates data augmentation to maintain consistency across multiple observations. SPR demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on the Atari 100k benchmark with limited data.

type.justification: The paper includes numerous experiments and evaluations, showcasing and comparing the performance of SPR with other methods using empirical data from the Atari 100k benchmark.
type.quote: Our method...achieves a median human-normalized score of 0.415 on Atari in a setting limited to 100k steps...exceeds expert human scores on 7 out of 26 games.
